mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to exceed baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained FEDFUNDS declines, or FEDFUNDS show no consistent downward trend over 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as elevated labor costs and weak job market sentiment reduce corporate growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.4 percentage points in 3 months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-negative despite UNRATE crossing above 4.0%, or the rate increase is not sustained beyond 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in FEDFUNDS below 2% and sustained growth in GDPC1 (demand) create a dual easing environment, compressing discount rates and boosting corporate earnings expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2.0% AND GDPC1 increases > 1% over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when both FEDFUNDS < 2% and GDPC1 increases >1%, or the conditions are not met.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, sustained increases in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signal over-tightening monetary policy, compressing equity discount rates and reducing growth expectations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 3.5%, or the rate increase is not sustained over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) signals robust production growth and lower inflationary pressures, fostering positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of sustained INDPRO growth, or the trend is not upward.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in PAYEMS below 1.2 million indicates accelerating labor market tightness and potential inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-negative despite PAYEMS falling below 1.2 million, or the drop is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rates (UNRATE > 4%) combined with exceptionally low FEDFUNDS rates (<2%) create a contradictory policy environment, raising inflation expectations and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite the combined UNRATE and FEDFUNDS conditions, or the interaction is not sustained.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery, simultaneous growth in GDPC1 (demand) above 1% and falling FEDFUNDS below 2% create a favorable dual environment, lowering discount rates and boosting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns fail to rise significantly (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 increases >1% and FEDFUNDS <2%, or the conditions are not met.
